title: Qibla Direction — Find the Qibla From Your Location | QuickTiny
desc: Find the Qibla direction from your current location or city in degrees from north, plus the distance to the Kaaba and today's prayer times. Free, no app needed.
intro: Tap “Use my location” or pick your city to see the Qibla direction in degrees from true north and the distance to the Kaaba. Turn until your phone's compass shows that number.
about:
Tips

  • Hold the phone flat and away from metal or electronics.
  • The direction follows the shortest path on the globe (great circle) — from North America it points north-east.
faq: Why does the Qibla from America point north-east?
Because the shortest route on a globe isn't a straight line on a flat map.
